messages.subject: Shiny loop to display multiple word clouds and labels
parts:
Hi, 
Following example from https://gist.github.com/wch/5436415/  and discussion at Stack Overflow, I managed to make the UI display multiple word cloud plots. 
Each of the plots needs its own title/label so the user knows what each word cloud plot is for. I'm not sure how to achieve that. At the moment I have below code in renderUI()

fixedRow(
            uiOutput("plabels"),
            uiOutput("plots")
          ),


The result is like this:

 label 1
 label 2
 label 3
 world cloud 1
 word cloud 2
 word cloud 3Enter code here...


What I want to achieve is:

 label 1
 word cloud 1
 label 2
 word cloud 2
 label 3
 word cloud 3

Is there a way to iterate uiOutput("plabels") and uiOutput("plots") to manipulate when to display which element?
Thank you very much in advance.
